generations.text: Marco Natarajan contacted support because the Orbit Cam misses motion at night since 2026-03-30. It is a High priority case and the status is currently Closed. The case was escalated to tier 2 on 2026-04-03. The knowledge base notes that Nimbus Hub needs a 2-hour cool-down before a factory reset. Invoice INV-94559 was issued on 2026-04-20 for the repair. The customer seems satisfied with the proposed next step.
